birch.description: Trees look like ghosts, but they bring life - and stories you'd be wise not to forget

candy.description: A sweet land where everything looks edible, and every bite is shared

celestial.description: Trees here grow so high, they brush other worlds - and sometimes, something brushes back

clover.description: Luck grows here... but it doesn't say who gets to keep it

corrupted.description: Once a dream of eternal life. Now a place that feeds - not out of hunger, but loneliness

crystal.description: Every surface reflects. You'll see every cut. And who made it

desert.description: The Golden Sands do not seek to destroy. They want to understand - by consuming everything first

enchanted.description: So beautiful, it makes you forget your dreams. You may never want to leave this place alive

flower.description: A land where symmetry gave rise to beauty - so pretty, yet so suspicious

garlic.description: This place doesn't need anyone - the smell welcomes you to stay away

grass.description: The most average biome imaginable. Great for touching

hills.description: Low hills. A lot of stone can be found here

infernal.description: A land scorched by love and betrayal - where fire is the least dangerous thing

jungle.description: Like a green ocean made of trees. Life swims through it... and so does death

maple.description: Endless autumn, where the leaves fall slower than apologies. Looks nice, eh?

mushroom.description: Fungi helped the trees grow... then decided they could do it better

paradox.description: Time has no meaning here. The past melts into the future, and memory is... fishy

permafrost.description: Beneath the frozen soil lie secrets too cold to die. They wait for a reason to rise

rocklands.description: Land of sleeping giants. They dream of a time long gone. A time they can never return to

savanna.description: Where humanity first stood tall - and started running from its problems

singularity_swamp.description: Everything sinks here, even reality itself. Sometimes it all comes back... just not where it should

swamp.description: One of evolution's oldest playgrounds, where the experiments never stopped

tumor.description: Grows on land and devours everything on it's way. Burns very well

wasteland.description: This is where our grandkids will live. But hey, not our problem
